title: Sagittarius Season.
old_caption: Tonight's forecast: adventure, blunt honesty and a giant YES stamp. The date is across town, and they packed three bags plus a pouch of tissues. Happy Sagittarius season. Where should the next date be?

title: Scorpio Season.
old_caption: Tonight's love forecast for Scorpio season: heavy eye contact, diaries locked, and 'maybe' not found. Expect long stares and zero small talk. Scorpios, is this accurate?

title: Aries × Cancer: A Survival Guide.
old_caption:
One of you is already outside, the other is still under a blanket. Different speeds can still meet in the middle.
Slow down a little, ask for a minute when you need one, and find your shared pace.

title: Scorpio × Libra: A Survival Guide.
old_caption: Scorpio wants depth, Libra wants harmony. Libra, share what you actually think. Scorpio, not everything is a test. Depth and balance can make a lovely pair.

title: Virgo × Sagittarius: A Survival Guide.
old_caption: A planner and a free spirit. Virgo, leave one blank square for fun. Sagittarius, text when you land. Structure and adventure can make a wonderful road trip together.

title: Abducted.
old_caption: Mixed signals confuse even a lab full of aliens. If you like them, say it plainly: clear is kind, to them and to you. Save this for the next time you type "whatever :)".

title: The air signs draft a text.
old_caption: Gemini wants a joke, Libra wants it deleted, Aquarius wants to send a cat meme, and somehow it became a 412-word essay. Which air sign is drafting your texts?

title: Dear Aquarius…
old_caption: Aquarius floating alone in the corner with headphones on, being different on purpose. Then Leo waves, and suddenly the headphones are off. Aquarius, who got you to take them off?

title: Dear Cancer…
old_caption: Dear Cancer: the shell is cute, we made it. Peeking out with teary eyes is also very cute. Tag the Cancer who needs a gentle nudge out of the shell.

title: Dear Capricorn…
old_caption: Every square on Capricorn's calendar says WORK, except one tiny pink one that says LOVE (Q3). The stars don't do calendar invites. Capricorn, when did you last close the laptop?
